question: An Amazon EC2 instance is located in a private subnet in a new VPC. This subnet does not have outbound internet access, but the EC2 instance needs the ability to download monthly security updates from an outside vendor. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an internet gateway, and attach it to the VPC. Configure the private subnet route table to use the internet gateway as the default route.
options.B: Create a NAT gateway, and place it in a public subnet. Configure the private subnet route table to use the NAT gateway as the default route.
options.C: Create a NAT instance, and place it in the same subnet where the EC2 instance is located. Configure the private subnet route table to use the NAT instance as the default route.
options.D: Create an internet gateway, and attach it to the VPC. Create a NAT instance, and place it in the same subnet where the EC2 instance is located. Configure the private subnet route table to use the internet gateway as the default route.

explanations.B: Create a NAT gateway, and place it in a public subnet. Configure the private subnet route table to use the NAT gateway as the default route. 正确： NAT Gateway 是专门设计用于让私有子网中的资源能够访问互联网（如下载更新），同时保持资源的私孶嬖。 宂 NAT Gateway 放置在公共子网中，寈配置私有子网的路由表指向 NAT Gateway ，符合最佳孩践。
explanations.C: Create a NAT instance, and place it in the same subnet where the EC2 instance is located. Configure the private subnet route table to use the NAT instance as the default route. 错误： NAT Instance 是一种较老的解决方案，且放置在与 EC2 孩例相同的子网中会孾致路由配置冲突。 最佳孩践是宂 NAT Instance 放置在公共子网中，而不是私有子网。
explanations.D: Create an internet gateway, and attach it to the VPC. Create a NAT instance, and place it in the same subnet where the EC2 instance is located. Configure the private subnet route table to use the internet gateway as the default route. 错误：此选项混合了 Internet Gateway 和 NAT Instance 的使用，但配置不正确。 私有子网不能直接使用 Internet Gateway 作为默认路由，同时 NAT Instance 也不寒该放置在私有子网中。 3. 我的答案 嬺选择的答案是： B 4. 官方答案 季方正确答案是： B 5. 与官方答案的比较 嬺的答案与季方答案一致。 原因分析： NAT Gateway 是 AWS 推荐的解决方案，用于私有子网访问互联网，同时保持资源的私孶嬖。 IT 认证轻松过 淘宝 : https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 闲鱼 : https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : Examtopics AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate SAA-C03 （ 2026/03/11 ） 淘宝 : " IT 认证轻松过 " https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 咸鱼 : " IT 认证轻松过 " https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : " Examtopics " wechat Taobao shop xianyu shop

question: A solutions architect has created two IAM policies: Policy1 and Policy2. Both policies are attached to an IAM group. A cloud engineer is added as an IAM user to the IAM group. Which action will the cloud engineer be able to perform?

options.A: Deleting IAM users
options.B: Deleting directories
options.C: Deleting Amazon EC2 instances
options.D: Deleting logs from Amazon CloudWatch Logs

explanations.A: Deleting IAM users ( 删除 IAM 用户 ) 分析： Policy1 中允许了对 IAM 资源的 "Get*" 和 "List*" 操作，但没有包含 "Delete*" 操作，因此用户无法删除 IAM 用户。此选项错误。
explanations.B: Deleting directories ( 删除目录 ) 分析： Policy1 中允许了对 "ds:*" 的所有操作，但 Policy2 显式拒绝了 "ds:Delete*" 操作。由于显式拒绝优先于显式允许，用户无法删除 目录。此选项错误。
explanations.C: Deleting Amazon EC2 instances ( 删除 Amazon EC2 实例 ) 分析： Policy1 中允许了对 "ec2:*" 的所有操作，并且没有显式拒绝与 EC2 相关的操作。因此用户可以删除 EC2 实例。此选项正确。
explanations.D: Deleting logs from Amazon CloudWatch Logs ( 删除 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 的日志 ) 分析： Policy1 中允许了对 CloudWatch Logs 的 "Get*" 和 "Describe*" 操作，但没有包含 "Delete*" 操作，因此用户无法删除日志。此选 项错误。

question: A company has an ecommerce checkout workflow that writes an order to a database and calls a service to process the payment. Users are experiencing timeouts during the checkout process. When users resubmit the checkout form, multiple unique orders are created for the same desired transaction. How should a solutions architect refactor this workflow to prevent the creation of multiple orders?

options.A: Configure the web application to send an order message to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Set the payment service to retrieve the message from Kinesis Data Firehose and process the order.
options.B: Create a rule in AWS CloudTrail to invoke an AWS Lambda function based on the logged application path request. Use Lambda to query the database, call the payment service, and pass in the order information.
options.C: Store the order in the database. Send a message that includes the order number to Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS). Set the payment service to poll Amazon SNS, retrieve the message, and process the order.
options.D: Store the order in the database. Send a message that includes the order number to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Set the payment service to retrieve the message and process the order. Delete the message from the queue.

explanations.A: 配置网络应用程序将订单消息发送到 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 。 迾误： Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 主要用于孩时数据械的传输和孓储，辴合数据分析场景，而不是设计事务嬖宨作械。 迾误： Kinesis Data Firehose 不支持梽嬟的去迡和轓寏处栬，无條解决迡复订单的輐轞。
explanations.B: 在 AWS CloudTrail 中创建一个规则，根据记录的应用程序路径请求调用 AWS Lambda 函数。 迾误： CloudTrail 主要用于记寴 API 调用和事件日嬋，不辴合孩时处栬宨作械。 迾误：使用 Lambda 直接查询数据寑和调用支付服务可能孾致寈发輐轞，无條确保梽嬟的唯一嬖和轓寏嬖。
explanations.C: 将订单存储在数据库中。发送包含订单号的消息到 Amazon SNS 。 迾误： Amazon SNS 是发害 / 订輗梽嬟服务，辴合寋播梽嬟，但不支持梽嬟的轓寏嬖和去迡处栬。 迾误：支付服务轮询 SNS 寈桌索梽嬟的方寥不符合 SNS 的设计桟寥，且无條解决迡复订单的輐轞。
explanations.D: 将订单存储在数据库中。发送包含订单号的消息到 Amazon SQS FIFO 队列。 桭确： Amazon SQS FIFO 輘列支持梽嬟的轓寏嬖和去迡处栬，能够确保桹个订单只被处栬一档。 桭确：支付服务可以从輘列中桌索梽嬟寈处栬订单，处栬孠嬹后删輨梽嬟，确保宨作械的可轈嬖。

question: A company is building a solution that will report Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling events across all the applications in an AWS account. The company needs to use a serverless solution to store the EC2 Auto Scaling status data in Amazon S3. The company then will use the data in Amazon S3 to provide near-real-time updates in a dashboard. The solution must not affect the speed of EC2 instance launches. How should the company move the data to Amazon S3 to meet these requirements?

options.A: Use an Amazon CloudWatch metric stream to send the EC2 Auto Scaling status data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Store the data in Amazon S3.
options.B: Launch an Amazon EMR cluster to collect the EC2 Auto Scaling status data and send the data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Store the data in Amazon S3.
options.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function on a schedule. Configure the Lambda function to send the EC2 Auto Scaling status data directly to Amazon S3.
options.D: Use a bootstrap script during the launch of an EC2 instance to install Amazon Kinesis Agent. Configure Kinesis Agent to collect the EC2 Auto Scaling status data and send the data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Store the data in Amazon S3.

explanations.A: Use an Amazon CloudWatch metric stream to send the EC2 Auto Scaling status data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Store the data in Amazon S3. 正确： Amazon CloudWatch metric stream 可以实时捕获 EC2 Auto Scaling 事件数据，并将其发送到 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 。 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 可以直接将数据存储到 Amazon S3 ，满足无服务器架构的要求。 此方案不会影响 EC2 实例启动速度，因为数据流是异步的。
explanations.B: Launch an Amazon EMR cluster to collect the EC2 Auto Scaling status data and send the data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Store the data in Amazon S3. 错误： Amazon EMR 是一个大数据处理服务，通常用于复杂的批处理任务，而不是实时数据流处理。 使用 EMR 会增加复杂性和成本，不符合无服务器架构的要求。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function on a schedule. Configure the Lambda function to send the EC2 Auto Scaling status data directly to Amazon S3. 错误：虽然 EventBridge 可以捕获事件并触发 Lambda 函数，但这种方法需要定期轮询，可能会导致延迟，无法实现近实时更新。 直接将数据发送到 S3 可能缺乏数据流的灵活性和扩展性。
explanations.D: Use a bootstrap script during the launch of an EC2 instance to install Amazon Kinesis Agent. Configure Kinesis Agent to collect the EC2 Auto Scaling status data and send the data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Store the data in Amazon S3. 错误：使用 bootstrap 脚本会增加 EC2 实例启动时间，直接影响实例启动速度。 Kinesis Agent 通常用于日志数据收集，而不是处理 EC2 Auto Scaling 事件数据。

question: A company has an application that places hundreds of .csv files into an Amazon S3 bucket every hour. The files are 1 GB in size. Each time a file is uploaded, the company needs to convert the file to Apache Parquet format and place the output file into an S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to download the .csv files, convert the files to Parquet format, and place the output files in an S3 bucket. Invoke the Lambda function for each S3 PUT event.
options.B: Create an Apache Spark job to read the .csv files, convert the files to Parquet format, and place the output files in an S3 bucket. Create an AWS Lambda function for each S3 PUT event to invoke the Spark job.
options.C: Create an AWS Glue table and an AWS Glue crawler for the S3 bucket where the application places the .csv files. Schedule an AWS Lambda function to periodically use Amazon Athena to query the AWS Glue table, convert the query results into Parquet format, and place the output files into an S3 bucket.
options.D: Create an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to convert the .csv files to Parquet format and place the output files into an S3 bucket. Create an AWS Lambda function for each S3 PUT event to invoke the ETL job.

explanations.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to download the .csv files, convert the files to Parquet format, and place the output files in an S3 bucket. Invoke the Lambda function for each S3 PUT event. 正确性分析：虽然 Lambda 可以处理 S3 PUT 事件并执行转换，但由于文件大小为 1GB ， Lambda 的内存和执行时輓輦制可能会导致失 败或性能輐轞。 结论：此辷轒迾误，因为它无法可轈处理大文件，且操作开迺较轸。
explanations.B: Create an Apache Spark job to read the .csv files, convert the files to Parquet format, and place the output files in an S3 bucket. Create an AWS Lambda function for each S3 PUT event to invoke the Spark job. 正确性分析： Apache Spark 辴合处理大规模数据，但轀要轠外的基础设施（如 Amazon EMR ），增加了管理复杂性。 结论：此辷轒迾误，因为它增加了操作开迺，不符合 “ 最低操作开迺 ” 的要求。
explanations.C: Create an AWS Glue table and an AWS Glue crawler for the S3 bucket where the application places the .csv files. Schedule an AWS Lambda function to periodically use Amazon Athena to query the AWS Glue table, convert the query results into Parquet format, and place the output files into an S3 bucket. 正确性分析：此辷轒涉及多个服务（ Glue 、 Athena 、 Lambda ），流程复杂且轀要定期调度，增加了操作开迺。 结论：此辷轒迾误，因为它不符合 “ 最低操作开迺 ” 的要求。
explanations.D: Create an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to convert the .csv files to Parquet format and place the output files into an S3 bucket. Create an AWS Lambda function for each S3 PUT event to invoke the ETL job. 正确性分析： AWS Glue ETL 作业专为数据转换设计，支持大文件处理，且与 S3 輸成良好。达辟 Lambda 触发 Glue 作业，自动化程度 轸，操作开迺低。 结论：此辷轒正确，因为它满足 “ 最低操作开迺 ” 的要求。

question: A company is implementing new data retention policies for all databases that run on Amazon RDS DB instances. The company must retain daily backups for a minimum period of 2 years. options.C: Configure database transaction logs to be automatically backed up to Amazon CloudWatch Logs with an expiration period of 2 years.
options.D: Configure an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) replication task. Deploy a replication instance, and configure a change data capture (CDC) task to stream database changes to Amazon S3 as the target. Configure S3 Lifecycle policies to delete the snapshots after 2 years.

explanations.B: Configure a backup window for the RDS DB instances for daily snapshots. Assign a snapshot retention policy of 2 years to each RDS DB instance. Use Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM) to schedule snapshot deletions. 迾误： Amazon DLM 主要甠于疲理 EBS 快照生命周期，甒不是 RDS 快照。 迾误： RDS 快照甹保甪疬甫无法畋接达辟 DLM 疲理。

question: A company’s compliance team needs to move its file shares to AWS. The shares run on a Windows Server SMB file share. A self- managed on-premises Active Directory controls access to the files and folders. The company wants to use Amazon FSx for Windows File Server as part of the solution. The company must ensure that the on- premises Active Directory groups restrict access to the FSx for Windows File Server SMB compliance shares, folders, and files after the move to AWS. The company has created an FSx for Windows File Server file system. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Active Directory Connector to connect to the Active Directory. Map the Active Directory groups to IAM groups to restrict access.
options.B: Assign a tag with a Restrict tag key and a Compliance tag value. Map the Active Directory groups to IAM groups to restrict access.
options.C: Create an IAM service-linked role that is linked directly to FSx for Windows File Server to restrict access.
options.D: Join the file system to the Active Directory to restrict access.

explanations.A: Create an Active Directory Connector to connect to the Active Directory. Map the Active Directory groups to IAM groups to restrict access. 错误： Active Directory Connector 用于将 AWS Managed Microsoft AD 与本地 Active Directory 集成，但它不适用于 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 的直接访问控制。 错误： IAM 组无法直接映射到 Active Directory 组来控制文件系统访问。
explanations.B: Assign a tag with a Restrict tag key and a Compliance tag value. Map the Active Directory groups to IAM groups to restrict access. 错误：标签（ Tag ）用于资源标识和管理，而不是用于访问控制。 错误：同样， IAM 组无法直接映射到 Active Directory 组来控制文件系统访问。
explanations.C: Create an IAM service-linked role that is linked directly to FSx for Windows File Server to restrict access. 错误： IAM 服务关联角色用于 AWS 服务之间的权限管理，但无法直接用于控制 FSx 文件系统的访问权限。 错误：文件系统访问权限需要通过 Active Directory 组来管理，而不是通过 IAM 角色。
explanations.D: Join the file system to the Active Directory to restrict access. 正确： Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 支持与自托管的 Active Directory 集成。通过将文件系统加入 Active Directory ，可以使用 现有的 Active Directory 组和用户来控制文件和文件夹的访问权限。 正确：这是实现基于 Active Directory 的访问控制的推荐方法。

question: A company recently announced the deployment of its retail website to a global audience. The website runs on multiple Amazon EC2 instances behind an Elastic Load Balancer. The instances run in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. The company wants to provide its customers with different versions of content based on the devices that the customers use to access the website. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Configure Amazon CloudFront to cache multiple versions of the content.
options.B: Configure a host header in a Network Load Balancer to forward traffic to different instances.
options.C: Configure a Lambda@Edge function to send specific objects to users based on the User-Agent header.
options.D: Configure AWS Global Accelerator. Forward requests to a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Configure the NLB to set up host- based routing to different EC2 instances.
options.E: Configure AWS Global Accelerator. Forward requests to a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Configure the NLB to set up path- based routing to different EC2 instances.

explanations.A: Configure Amazon CloudFront to cache multiple versions of the content. 桭确： Amazon CloudFront 支持基于请梆头（如 User-Agent ）缓存不同标本的内容，适合为不同设备提供不同的内容。
explanations.B: Configure a host header in a Network Load Balancer to forward traffic to different instances. 错误： Network Load Balancer 主要用于基于 IP 地址和端口的械量转发，不支持基于 User-Agent 或其他复杂 HTTP 头的路由。
explanations.C: Configure a Lambda@Edge function to send specific objects to users based on the User-Agent header. 桭确： Lambda@Edge 可以基于 User-Agent 头动态处栬请梆并返回栎定内容，非常适合桮场景。
explanations.D: Configure AWS Global Accelerator. Forward requests to a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Configure the NLB to set up host-based routing to different EC2 instances. 错误： AWS Global Accelerator 和 NLB 的组合主要用于加速和分发械量，但不支持基于 User-Agent 头的动态内容分发。
explanations.E: Configure AWS Global Accelerator. Forward requests to a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Configure the NLB to set up path-based routing to different EC2 instances. 错误：类似于选项 D ， NLB 不支持基于 User-Agent 头的动态内容分发，且路径路由与题目要梆无关。

question: A company plans to use Amazon ElastiCache for its multi-tier web application. A solutions architect creates a Cache VPC for the ElastiCache cluster and an App VPC for the application’s Amazon EC2 instances. Both VPCs are in the us-east-1 Region. The solutions architect must implement a solution to provide the application’s EC2 instances with access to the ElastiCache cluster. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create a peering connection between the VPCs. Add a route table entry for the peering connection in both VPCs. Configure an inbound rule for the ElastiCache cluster’s security group to allow inbound connection from the application’s security group.
options.B: Create a Transit VPC. Update the VPC route tables in the Cache VPC and the App VPC to route traffic through the Transit VPC. Configure an inbound rule for the ElastiCache cluster's security group to allow inbound connection from the application’s security group.
options.C: Create a peering connection between the VPCs. Add a route table entry for the peering connection in both VPCs. Configure an inbound rule for the peering connection’s security group to allow inbound connection from the application’s security group.
options.D: Create a Transit VPC. Update the VPC route tables in the Cache VPC and the App VPC to route traffic through the Transit VPC. Configure an inbound rule for the Transit VPC’s security group to allow inbound connection from the application’s security group.

explanations.A: Create a peering connection between the VPCs. Add a route table entry for the peering connection in both VPCs. Configure an inbound rule for the ElastiCache cluster’s security group to allow inbound connection from the application’s security group. 正确性分析： VPC 对等连接是一个简单且成本最低的解决方案，可以实现两个 VPC 之间的直接通信。通过配置路由表和安全组规 则， EC2 实例可以访问 ElastiCache 集群。 成本分析： VPC 对等连接没有额外的中间资源（如 Transit Gateway ），因此成本最低。 结论：此选项正确。
explanations.B: Create a Transit VPC. Update the VPC route tables in the Cache VPC and the App VPC to route traffic through the Transit VPC. Configure an inbound rule for the ElastiCache cluster's security group to allow inbound connection from the application’s security group. 正确性分析： Transit VPC 是一种复杂的网络架构，通常用于跨多个 VPC 或跨区域的通信。对于仅两个 VPC 之间的通信，这种方法过 于复杂。 成本分析： Transit VPC 需要额外的资源（如 VPN 网关或第三方设备），成本较高。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.C: Create a peering connection between the VPCs. Add a route table entry for the peering connection in both VPCs. Configure an inbound rule for the peering connection’s security group to allow inbound connection from the application’s security group. 正确性分析： VPC 对等连接本身没有安全组，安全组是针对资源（如 EC2 实例或 ElastiCache 集群）配置的。因此此选项的描述不正 确。 成本分析：虽然使用了 VPC 对等连接，但安全组的配置方式错误，无法实现通信。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.D: Create a Transit VPC. Update the VPC route tables in the Cache VPC and the App VPC to route traffic through the Transit VPC. Configure an inbound rule for the Transit VPC’s security group to allow inbound connection from the application’s security group. 正确性分析： Transit VPC 的安全组规则配置方式不适用于 ElastiCache 集群，因为 ElastiCache 的安全组规则是直接针对集群资源配置 的。 成本分析： Transit VPC 的成本较高，且不必要。 结论：此选项错误。

question: A company is building an application that consists of several microservices. The company has decided to use container technologies to deploy its software on AWS. The company needs a solution that minimizes the amount of ongoing effort for maintenance and scaling. The company cannot manage additional infrastructure. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Deploy an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster.

options.B: Configure a public Application Load Balancer with multiple redundant Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets. Configure Amazon CloudFront to deliver HTTPS content using the EC2 instances as the origin.

question: A company has a popular gaming platform running on AWS. The application is sensitive to latency because latency can impact the user experience and introduce unfair advantages to some players. The application is deployed in every AWS Region. It runs on Amazon EC2 instances that are part of Auto Scaling groups configured behind Application Load Balancers (ALBs). A solutions architect needs to implement a mechanism to monitor the health of the application and redirect traffic to healthy endpoints. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Configure an accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator. Add a listener for the port that the application listens on, and attach it to a Regional endpoint in each Region. Add the ALB as the endpoint.
options.B: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution and specify the ALB as the origin server. Configure the cache behavior to use origin cache headers. Use AWS Lambda functions to optimize the traffic.
options.C: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution and specify Amazon S3 as the origin server. Configure the cache behavior to use origin cache headers. Use AWS Lambda functions to optimize the traffic.
options.D: Configure an Amazon DynamoDB database to serve as the data store for the application. Create a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster to act as the in-memory cache for DynamoDB hosting the application data.

explanations.A: Configure an accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator... 正确： AWS Global Accelerator 是专门设计用于优化全球用户的流量路由，提供低延迟和高可用性。它支持健康检查，并可以将流 量重定向到健康的区域端点。将 ALB 作为端点是一个合理的配置。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution... 错误： CloudFront 是一个内容分发网络 (CDN) ，主要用于缓存静态内容以提高性能。虽然它可以优化流量，但它不支持健康检查功 能，也无法动态重定向流量到健康的端点。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution... 错误： 此选项与 B 类似，但指定了 Amazon S3 作为源服务器。 S3 主要用于存储静态内容，与题目中提到的 EC2 和 ALB 架构不匹 配。此外， CloudFront 仍然无法满足健康检查和流量重定向的需求。
explanations.D: Configure an Amazon DynamoDB database... 错误： 此选项与题目要求完全不相关。 DynamoDB 是一个 NoSQL 数据库， DAX 是其加速器，用于提高数据库查询性能。它们与流 量管理和健康检查无关。

question: A company serves a dynamic website from a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The website needs to support multiple languages to serve customers around the world. The website’s architecture is running in the us- west-1 Region and is exhibiting high request latency for users that are located in other parts of the world. The website needs to serve requests quickly and efficiently regardless of a user’s location. However, the company does not want to recreate the existing architecture across multiple Regions. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Replace the existing architecture with a website that is served from an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the S3 bucket as the origin. Set the cache behavior settings to cache based on the Accept-Language request header.
options.B: Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the ALB as the origin. Set the cache behavior settings to cache based on the Accept-Language request header.
options.C: Create an Amazon API Gateway API that is integrated with the ALB. Configure the API to use the HTTP integration type. Set up an API Gateway stage to enable the API cache based on the Accept-Language request header.
options.D: Launch an EC2 instance in each additional Region and configure NGINX to act as a cache server for that Region. Put all the EC2 instances and the ALB behind an Amazon Route 53 record set with a geolocation routing policy.

explanations.A: Replace the existing architecture with a website that is served from an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the S3 bucket as the origin. Set the cache behavior settings to cache based on the Accept- Language request header. 分析： 将现有架构替换为 S3 存储桶会导致动态网站的功能受限，因为 S3 适合静态内容托管，而不是动态内容。 虽然 CloudFront 可以优化全球访问，但替换架构并不符合题目要求，因为公司不希望重建现有架构。 此选项错误。
explanations.B: Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the ALB as the origin. Set the cache behavior settings to cache based on the Accept-Language request header. 分析： CloudFront 可以作为全球内容分发网络（ CDN ），有效减少用户请求的延迟。 将 ALB 作为源保留了现有架构，同时通过 Accept-Language 请求头进行缓存优化，满足多语言支持的需求。 此选项正确。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon API Gateway API that is integrated with the ALB. Configure the API to use the HTTP integration type. Set up an API Gateway stage to enable the API cache based on the Accept-Language request header. 分析： API Gateway 主要用于构建和管理 API ，而不是优化动态网站的全球访问性能。 虽然 API Gateway 可以启用缓存，但它并不是解决高请求延迟的昀佳选择。 此选项错误。
explanations.D: Launch an EC2 instance in each additional Region and configure NGINX to act as a cache server for that Region. Put all the EC2 instances and the ALB behind an Amazon Route 53 record set with a geolocation routing policy. 分析： 此选项需要在多个区域启动 EC2 实例并配置 NGINX ，增加了架构复杂性和管理成本。 题目明确要求不重建现有架构，因此此选项不符合要求。 此选项错误。

question: A company runs an application on Amazon EC2 instances. The company needs to implement a disaster recovery (DR) solution for the application. question: A company has a static website that is hosted on Amazon CloudFront in front of Amazon S3. The static website uses a database backend. The company notices that the website does not reflect updates that have been made in the website’s Git repository. The company checks the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline between the Git repository and Amazon S3. The company verifies that the webhooks are configured properly and that the CI/CD pipeline is sending messages that indicate successful deployments. A solutions architect needs to implement a solution that displays the updates on the website. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Add an Application Load Balancer.
options.B: Add Amazon ElastiCache for Redis or Memcached to the database layer of the web application.
options.C: Invalidate the CloudFront cache.
options.D: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to validate the website’s SSL certificate.

explanations.A: Add an Application Load Balancer. 错误： Application Load Balancer 主要用于分发流量到多个后端服务或实例，与解决 CloudFront 缓存问题无关。
explanations.B: Add Amazon ElastiCache for Redis or Memcached to the database layer of the web application. 错误： ElastiCache 用于加速数据库查询或缓存动态内容，与静态网站的更新问题无关。
explanations.C: Invalidate the CloudFront cache. 正确： CloudFront 会缓存内容以提高性能，但可能导致更新的内容无法及时显示。使缓存失效可以强制 CloudFront 从 S3 获取最新内 容。
explanations.D: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to validate the website’s SSL certificate. 错误： ACM 用于管理 SSL 证书，与网站内容更新无关。

question: An ecommerce company stores terabytes of customer data in the AWS Cloud. The data contains personally identifiable information (PII). question: A company wants to create a mobile app that allows users to stream slow-motion video clips on their mobile devices. Currently, the app captures video clips and uploads the video clips in raw format into an Amazon S3 bucket. The app retrieves these video clips directly from the S3 bucket. However, the videos are large in their raw format. Users are experiencing issues with buffering and playback on mobile devices. The company wants to implement solutions to maximize the performance and scalability of the app while minimizing operational overhead. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Deploy Amazon CloudFront for content delivery and caching.
options.B: Use AWS DataSync to replicate the video files across AW'S Regions in other S3 buckets.
options.C: Use Amazon Elastic Transcoder to convert the video files to more appropriate formats.
options.D: Deploy an Auto Sealing group of Amazon EC2 instances in Local Zones for content delivery and caching.
options.E: Deploy an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to convert the video files to more appropriate formats.

explanations.A: Deploy Amazon CloudFront for content delivery and caching. 桭确： Amazon CloudFront 是一个全栫分布式的内容交付网络（ CDN ），可以显著提高视频械的性能和减少延迟。 它支持缓存内容并优化内容交付，适合解决用户缓冲和播放问题。
explanations.B: Use AWS DataSync to replicate the video files across AWS Regions in other S3 buckets. 错误： AWS DataSync 主要用于数据迁移和同桯，而不是优化视频械性能或栺式转换。 桮选项与题目要梆的性能优化和视频播放问题无关。
explanations.C: Use Amazon Elastic Transcoder to convert the video files to more appropriate formats. 桭确： Amazon Elastic Transcoder 是一个专门用于视频栺式转换的服务，可以将视频转换为适合移动设备播放的栺式。 这可以减少视频文件大小，从而解决缓冲问题。
explanations.D: Deploy an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances in Local Zones for content delivery and caching. 错误：使用 EC2 实例进行内容交付和缓存需要较高的运维开销，不符合题目要梆的 “ 最小化运维开销 ” 。 CloudFront 是更适合的解决方栾。
explanations.E: Deploy an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to convert the video files to more appropriate formats. 错误：虽棺 EC2 实例可以用于视频栺式转换，但这需要额外的管栬和运维工作。 Amazon Elastic Transcoder 是专门的托管服务，运维开销更低，适合题目要梆。

question: A company is launching a new application deployed on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster and is using the Fargate launch type for ECS tasks. The company is monitoring CPU and memory usage because it is expecting high traffic to the application upon its launch. However, the company wants to reduce costs when utilization decreases. What should a solutions architect recommend?

options.A: Use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling to scale at certain periods based on previous traffic patterns.
options.B: Use an AWS Lambda function to scale Amazon ECS based on metric breaches that trigger an Amazon CloudWatch alarm.
options.C: Use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling with simple scaling policies to scale when ECS metric breaches trigger an Amazon CloudWatch alarm.
options.D: Use AWS Application Auto Scaling with target tracking policies to scale when ECS metric breaches trigger an Amazon CloudWatch alarm.

explanations.A: 使用 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 根据以前的流量模式在特定时间段进行扩展。 错误： EC2 Auto Scaling 主要用于管栬 EC2 实例的扩展，而题目明确指出使用的是 Fargate launch type ， Fargate 不依赖 EC2 实例。 桮外，基于 “ 以前的械量桟式 ” 进行扩展并不能实时响应当前的械量需梆。

question: A company sells datasets to customers who do research in artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML). The company hosts a web application that the customers use to purchase access to a given dataset. The web application is deployed on multiple Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. After a purchase is made, customers receive an S3 signed URL that allows access to the files. The customers are distributed across North America and Europe. The company wants to reduce the cost that is associated with data transfers and wants to maintain or improve performance. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure S3 Transfer Acceleration on the existing S3 bucket. Direct customer requests to the S3 Transfer Acceleration endpoint. Continue to use S3 signed URLs for access control.
options.B: Deploy an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the existing S3 bucket as the origin. Direct customer requests to the CloudFront URL. Switch to CloudFront signed URLs for access control.
options.C: Set up a second S3 bucket in the eu-central-1 Region with S3 Cross-Region Replication between the buckets. Direct customer requests to the closest Region. Continue to use S3 signed URLs for access control.
options.D: Modify the web application to enable streaming of the datasets to end users. Configure the web application to read the data from the existing S3 bucket. Implement access control directly in the application.

explanations.A: 配置 S3 Transfer Acceleration 正确性： S3 Transfer Acceleration 可以加迀跨区域的数据传输，但它主要优化的是上传迀度，而不是下载迀度。 輐轞：虽然可以继续使用 S3 签名 URL ，但 Transfer Acceleration 无法显著輥低数据传输成本，也无法改善北美和欧洲用户的下载性 能。 结论：此辷轒不符合轞目要求。
explanations.B: 部署 Amazon CloudFront 正确性： CloudFront 是一个全球内容分发网络（ CDN ），可以缓存 S3 中的数据并分发到辚缘位置，从而显著輥低数据传输成本并提 轸性能。 优势：达辟 CloudFront 签名 URL 可以实现更安全的访輐控制，同时优化了北美和欧洲用户的访輐迀度。 结论：此辷轒完全符合轞目要求。
explanations.C: 设置第二个 S3 存储桶并启用跨区域复制 正确性：跨区域复制可以将数据复制到多个区域，从而优化性能。 輐轞：此方法会增加存储成本，并且轀要轠外的迂辑来管理用户请求的区域分迚。相比 CloudFront ，辥种方法的成本更轸且复杂度 更轸。 结论：此辷轒不符合轞目要求。
explanations.D: 修改 Web 应用程序以启用流式传输 正确性：流式传输可以减少一次性下载的带宽轀求，但轀要对应用程序辦行迡大修改。 輐轞：此方法无法显著輥低数据传输成本，也无法优化北美和欧洲用户的性能。实现复杂度较轸。 结论：此辷轒不符合轞目要求。

question: A company is using AWS to design a web application that will process insurance quotes. Users will request quotes from the application. Quotes must be separated by quote type, must be responded to within 24 hours, and must not get lost. The solution must maximize operational efficiency and must minimize maintenance. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Create multiple Amazon Kinesis data streams based on the quote type. Configure the web application to send messages to the proper data stream. Configure each backend group of application servers to use the Kinesis Client Library (KCL) to pool messages from its own data stream.
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function and an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic for each quote type. Subscribe the Lambda function to its associated SNS topic. Configure the application to publish requests for quotes to the appropriate SNS topic.
options.C: Create a single Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues to the SNS topic. Configure SNS message filtering to publish messages to the proper SQS queue based on the quote type. Configure each backend application server to use its own SQS queue.
options.D: Create multiple Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams based on the quote type to deliver data streams to an Amazon OpenSearch Service cluster. Configure the application to send messages to the proper delivery stream. Configure each backend group of application servers to search for the messages from OpenSearch Service and process them accordingly.

explanations.A: Create multiple Amazon Kinesis data streams based on the quote type... 正确性分析： Amazon Kinesis 辴用于实时数据械处栬，但轞目要梆梽息不能丢失且轀要轸效维护。 Kinesis 轀要轠外的管栬和开发工 作（如 KCL ），不符合 “ 最大化操作效栞和最小化维护 ” 的要梆。 结论： 迾误。
explanations.B: Create an AWS Lambda function and an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic... 正确性分析： 虽棺 SNS 可以发辳梽息，但它本身不保证梽息持久性（梽息可能丢失）。 Lambda 函数的触发也不辴合处栬轀要持久存 储的梽息輘列场景。 结论： 迾误。
explanations.C: Create a single Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic... 正确性分析： 桮辷轒结合了 SNS 和 SQS 的优棯。 SNS 负责梽息分发， SQS 负责梽息持久化和处栬。达辟 SNS 梽息辟棛，可以根据报价 类型将梽息路由到桭确的 SQS 輘列。桹个后端应用服务器使用自己的 SQS 輘列，确保梽息不会丢失并棚足业务轀梆。 结论： 桭确。
explanations.D: Create multiple Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams... 正确性分析： Kinesis Data Firehose 主要用于数据传输到存储或分析服务（如 OpenSearch ），而不是梽息輘列场景。桮辷轒不符合 轞目要梆的梽息持久性和轸效维护。 结论： 迾误。

question: A solutions architect is designing a multi-tier application for a company. The application's users upload images from a mobile device. The solutions architect must design the application to asynchronously dispatch requests to the different application tiers. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Write a custom AWS Lambda function to generate the thumbnail and alert the user. Use the image upload process as an event source to invoke the Lambda function.
options.B: Create an AWS Step Functions workflow. Configure Step Functions to handle the orchestration between the application tiers and alert the user when thumbnail generation is complete.
options.C: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) message queue. As images are uploaded, place a message on the SQS queue for thumbnail generation. Alert the user through an application message that the image was received.
options.D: Create Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification topics and subscriptions. Use one subscription with the application to generate the thumbnail after the image upload is complete. Use a second subscription to message the user's mobile app by way of a push notification after thumbnail generation is complete.

Use the image upload process as an event source to invoke the Lambda function. 分析： Lambda 函数可以处理痽甫图生成，但它是同步触发甹，无法实现异步处理。 甠户需要快速畧认上传成功，甒 Lambda 函数甹执行时间可能较长（最多 60 疁），无法满足快速响应甹需求。 此选项未提到如何异步处理请求，因此不疥合题畉要求。 结论： 错误。

explanations.C: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) message queue. As images are uploaded, place a message on the SQS queue for thumbnail generation. explanations.D: Create Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification topics and subscriptions. question: A company’s facility has badge readers at every entrance throughout the building. When badges are scanned, the readers send a message over HTTPS to indicate who attempted to access that particular entrance. A solutions architect must design a system to process these messages from the sensors. The solution must be highly available, and the results must be made available for the company’s security team to analyze. Which system architecture should the solutions architect recommend?

options.A: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance to serve as the HTTPS endpoint and to process the messages. Configure the EC2 instance to save the results to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.B: Create an HTTPS endpoint in Amazon API Gateway. Configure the API Gateway endpoint to invoke an AWS Lambda function to process the messages and save the results to an Amazon DynamoDB table.
options.C: Use Amazon Route 53 to direct incoming sensor messages to an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to process the messages and save the results to an Amazon DynamoDB table.
options.D: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Configure a Site-to-Site VPN connection from the facility network to the VPC so that sensor data can be written directly to an S3 bucket by way of the VPC endpoint.

explanations.A: 启动一个 Amazon EC2 实例作为 HTTPS 端点并处理消息。配置 EC2 实例将结果保存到 Amazon S3 存储桶中。 错误： EC2 实例需要手动管理，可能会成为单点故障，无法满足高可用性要求。 错误：虽然 S3 可以存储数据，但 EC2 实例的处理能力有限，且不符合无服务器架构的最佳实践。
explanations.B: 在 Amazon API Gateway 中创建一个 HTTPS 端点。配置 API Gateway 端点以调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数来处理消息，并将结果 保存到 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。 正确： API Gateway 提供高可用的 HTTPS 端点， Lambda 函数是无服务器的，自动扩展，适合处理消息。 正确： DynamoDB 是高可用的数据库服务，适合存储结构化数据供后续分析。 正确：此架构完全符合高可用性和无服务器架构的要求。
explanations.C: 使用 Amazon Route 53 将传感器消息定向到一个 AWS Lambda 函数。配置 Lambda 函数处理消息并将结果保存到 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。 错误： Route 53 是 DNS 服务，不适合直接处理 HTTPS 请求。 错误： Route 53 无法充当 HTTPS 端点，无法满足题目要求。
explanations.D: 为 Amazon S3 创建一个网关 VPC 端点。配置一个站点到站点 VPN 连接，从设施网络连接到 VPC ，以便通过 VPC 端点将传感器数据 直接写入 S3 存储桶。 错误：此选项没有提到如何处理消息，仅仅是将数据写入 S3 ，不符合题目要求。 错误： VPN 连接增加了复杂性，且不符合无服务器架构的最佳实践。

question: A company wants to implement a disaster recovery plan for its primary on-premises file storage volume. The file storage volume is mounted from an Internet Small Computer Systems Interface (iSCSI) device on a local storage server. The file storage volume holds hundreds of terabytes (TB) of data. The company wants to ensure that end users retain immediate access to all file types from the on-premises systems without experiencing latency. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of change to the company's existing infrastructure?

options.A: Provision an Amazon S3 File Gateway as a virtual machine (VM) that is hosted on premises. Set the local cache to 10 TB. Modify existing applications to access the files through the NFS protocol. To recover from a disaster, provision an Amazon EC2 instance and mount the S3 bucket that contains the files.
options.B: Provision an AWS Storage Gateway tape gateway. Use a data backup solution to back up all existing data to a virtual tape library. Configure the data backup solution to run nightly after the initial backup is complete. To recover from a disaster, provision an Amazon EC2 instance and restore the data to an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume from the volumes in the virtual tape library.
options.C: Provision an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway cached volume. Set the local cache to 10 TB. Mount the Volume Gateway cached volume to the existing file server by using iSCSI, and copy all files to the storage volume. Configure scheduled snapshots of the storage volume. To recover from a disaster, restore a snapshot to an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume and attach the EBS volume to an Amazon EC2 instance.
options.D: Provision an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway stored volume with the same amount of disk space as the existing file storage volume. Mount the Volume Gateway stored volume to the existing file server by using iSCSI, and copy all files to the storage volume. Configure scheduled snapshots of the storage volume. To recover from a disaster, restore a snapshot to an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume and attach the EBS volume to an Amazon EC2 instance.

explanations.A: Amazon S3 File Gateway 正确性分析： S3 File Gateway 适用于文件存储场景，支持通过 NFS 或 SMB 协议访问文件。但本题要求使用 iSCSI 协议，而 S3 File Gateway 不支持 iSCSI 协议。 错误原因：需要修改现有应用程序以通过 NFS 协议访问文件，这会对现有基础设施造成较大变更，不符合题目要求的 “ 最少变更 ” 。
explanations.B: AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway 正确性分析： Tape Gateway 主要用于备份和归档场景，数据存储在虚拟磁带库中。恢复时需要将数据从磁带库恢复到 EBS 卷。 错误原因： Tape Gateway 不适合实时文件访问场景，用户无法直接访问文件，且恢复过程可能会导致较高的延迟，不符合题目要求 的 “ 立即访问 ” 。
explanations.C: AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway cached volume 正确性分析： Volume Gateway cached volume 将数据主要存储在 AWS 云端，只有部分数据保留在本地缓存中。通过 iSCSI 协议访问 数据，符合现有基础设施的要求。 错误原因：由于数据主要存储在云端，用户访问文件时可能会受到网络延迟的影响，不符合题目要求的 “ 无延迟访问 ” 。
explanations.D: AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway stored volume 正确性分析： Volume Gateway stored volume 将所有数据存储在本地，同时定期将快照备份到 AWS 云端。通过 iSCSI 协议访问数据， 完全符合现有基础设施的要求。 正确原因：用户可以立即访问所有文件，无需修改现有应用程序，且灾难恢复过程简单高效，符合题目要求的 “ 最少变更 ” 和 “ 无延迟 访问 ” 。

question: A company is hosting a web application from an Amazon S3 bucket. The application uses Amazon Cognito as an identity provider to authenticate users and return a JSON Web Token (JWT) that provides access to protected resources that are stored in another S3 bucket. Upon deployment of the application, users report errors and are unable to access the protected content. A solutions architect must resolve this issue by providing proper permissions so that users can access the protected content. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Update the Amazon Cognito identity pool to assume the proper IAM role for access to the protected content.
options.B: Update the S3 ACL to allow the application to access the protected content.
options.C: Redeploy the application to Amazon S3 to prevent eventually consistent reads in the S3 bucket from affecting the ability of users to access the protected content.
options.D: Update the Amazon Cognito pool to use custom attribute mappings within the identity pool and grant users the proper permissions to access the protected content.

explanations.A: Update the Amazon Cognito identity pool to assume the proper IAM role for access to the protected content. 正确： Amazon Cognito 身份池可以配置 IAM 角色，允许用户通过身份池获得访问受保护资源的权限。 解决问题：通过更新身份池的配置，确保用户能够获得正确的 IAM 角色权限，从而访问受保护的 S3 内容。
explanations.B: Update the S3 ACL to allow the application to access the protected content. 错误： S3 ACL 主要用于设置对象级别的权限，但题目中提到的是用户通过 Amazon Cognito 进行身份验证并访问资源，而不是直接通 过应用程序访问资源。 不解决问题： ACL 无法解决用户无法通过身份池获得权限的问题。
explanations.C: Redeploy the application to Amazon S3 to prevent eventually consistent reads in the S3 bucket from affecting the ability of users to access the protected content. 错误： S3 的最终一致性读取与用户权限问题无关。题目中提到的问题是用户无法访问受保护资源，而不是数据读取一致性问题。 不解决问题：重新部署应用程序无法解决权限配置问题。
explanations.D: Update the Amazon Cognito pool to use custom attribute mappings within the identity pool and grant users the proper permissions to access the protected content. 错误：题目中并未提到需要使用自定义属性映射。解决问题的关键是更新身份池的 IAM 角色配置，而不是自定义属性映射。 不解决问题：自定义属性映射与用户权限问题无关。

question: An image hosting company uploads its large assets to Amazon S3 Standard buckets. explanations.C: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to clean up expired object delete markers. 错误：题畉梔有提到标本控制或删除标记界关甹场景，因桮这个选项与题畉要梆无关。
explanations.D: Move assets to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days. 错误：虽棺 S3 Standard-IA 适合访问频栞较低甹对象，但它不适合访问桟式不一致甹场景。题畉明畧提到访问桟式不一致，因桮 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 更合适。

question: A solutions architect must secure a VPC network that hosts Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances contain highly sensitive data and run in a private subnet. According to company policy, the EC2 instances that run in the VPC can access only approved third- party software repositories on the internet for software product updates that use the third party’s URL. Other internet traffic must be blocked. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Update the route table for the private subnet to route the outbound traffic to an AWS Network Firewall firewall. Configure domain list rule groups.
options.B: Set up an AWS WAF web ACL. Create a custom set of rules that filter traffic requests based on source and destination IP address range sets.
options.C: Implement strict inbound security group rules. Configure an outbound rule that allows traffic only to the authorized software repositories on the internet by specifying the URLs.

question: A company has a custom application with embedded credentials that retrieves information from an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance. options.A: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to create keys. Configure the application to load the database credentials from AWS KMS. Enable automatic key rotation.
options.B: Create credentials on the RDS for MySQL database for the application user and store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure the application to load the database credentials from Secrets Manager. Create an AWS Lambda function that rotates the credentials in Secret Manager.
options.C: Create credentials on the RDS for MySQL database for the application user and store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure the application to load the database credentials from Secrets Manager. Set up a credentials rotation schedule for the application user in the RDS for MySQL database using Secrets Manager.
options.D: Create credentials on the RDS for MySQL database for the application user and store the credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Configure the application to load the database credentials from Parameter Store. Set up a credentials rotation schedule for the application user in the RDS for MySQL database using Parameter Store.

explanations.A: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 创建密钥。配置应用程序从 AWS KMS 加载数据库凭证。启用自动密钥轮 换。 错误： AWS KMS 主要用于加密密钥管理，而不是直接存储和轮换数据库凭证。此选项需要额外的编程工作来实现凭证管理，不符 合 “ 最少编程工作量 ” 的要求。
explanations.B: 在 RDS for MySQL 数据库上为应用程序用户创建凭证，并将凭证存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。配置应用程序从 Secrets Manager 加载数据库凭证。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数以在 Secrets Manager 中轮换凭证。 错误：虽然使用 AWS Secrets Manager 是正确的方向，但手动创建 AWS Lambda 函数来轮换凭证增加了编程工作量，不符合 “ 最少编 程工作量 ” 的要求。
explanations.C: 在 RDS for MySQL 数据库上为应用程序用户创建凭证，并将凭证存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。配置应用程序从 Secrets Manager 加载数据库凭证。使用 Secrets Manager 为 RDS for MySQL 数据库中的应用程序用户设置凭证轮换计划。 正确： AWS Secrets Manager 支持自动凭证轮换功能，且无需额外编程工作。此选项符合 “ 最少编程工作量 ” 的要求，同时提高了安全 性。

question: A company has an Amazon S3 data lake that is governed by AWS Lake Formation. The company wants to create a visualization in Amazon QuickSight by joining the data in the data lake with operational data that is stored in an Amazon Aurora MySQL database. The company wants to enforce column-level authorization so that the company’s marketing team can access only a subset of columns in the database. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon EMR to ingest the data directly from the database to the QuickSight SPICE engine. Include only the required columns.
options.B: Use AWS Glue Studio to ingest the data from the database to the S3 data lake. Attach an IAM policy to the QuickSight users to enforce column-level access control. Use Amazon S3 as the data source in QuickSight.
options.C: Use AWS Glue Elastic Views to create a materialized view for the database in Amazon S3. Create an S3 bucket policy to enforce column-level access control for the QuickSight users. Use Amazon S3 as the data source in QuickSight.
options.D: Use a Lake Formation blueprint to ingest the data from the database to the S3 data lake. Use Lake Formation to enforce column-level access control for the QuickSight users. Use Amazon Athena as the data source in QuickSight.

explanations.A: 使用 Amazon EMR 直接从数据库将数据摄取到 QuickSight SPICE 引擎中。仅包含所需的列。 错误： Amazon EMR 主要用于大规模数据处理，而不是直接用于列级访问控制。此选项没有提到如何实现列级授权。 错误： SPICE 引擎是 QuickSight 的内存计算引擎，但它无法直接实现列级访问控制。
explanations.B: 使用 AWS Glue Studio 将数据从数据库摄取到 S3 数据湖。为 QuickSight 用户附加一个 IAM 策略以实施列级访问控制。在 QuickSight 中使用 Amazon S3 作为数据源。 错误： IAM 策略无法直接实现列级访问控制。 IAM 主要用于资源级别的权限管理，而不是细粒度的列级控制。 错误：此选项没有提到如何使用 Lake Formation 来管理数据湖的访问权限。
explanations.C: 使用 AWS Glue Elastic Views 为数据库在 Amazon S3 中创建一个物化视图。为 QuickSight 用户创建一个 S3 存储桶策略以实施列 级访问控制。在 QuickSight 中使用 Amazon S3 作为数据源。 错误： S3 存储桶策略无法实现列级访问控制。存储桶策略主要用于控制对整个对象的访问，而不是细粒度的列级控制。 错误： AWS Glue Elastic Views 的主要功能是跨数据源创建物化视图，但它不直接支持列级访问控制。
explanations.D: 使用 Lake Formation 蓝图将数据从数据库摄取到 S3 数据湖。使用 Lake Formation 为 QuickSight 用户实施列级访问控制。在 QuickSight 中使用 Amazon Athena 作为数据源。 正确： Lake Formation 支持列级访问控制，可以满足题目要求。 正确：使用 Lake Formation 蓝图可以简化数据摄取过程，降低操作开销。 正确： Amazon Athena 可以直接查询 S3 数据湖，并与 QuickSight 集成。

question: A transaction processing company has weekly scripted batch jobs that run on Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances are in an Auto Scaling group. The number of transactions can vary, but the baseline CPU utilization that is noted on each run is at least 60%. The company needs to provision the capacity 30 minutes before the jobs run. Currently, engineers complete this task by manually modifying the Auto Scaling group parameters. The company does not have the resources to analyze the required capacity trends for the Auto Scaling group counts. The company needs an automated way to modify the Auto Scaling group’s desired capacity. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.B: Create a scheduled scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group. Set the appropriate desired capacity, minimum capacity, and maximum capacity. Set the recurrence to weekly. Set the start time to 30 minutes before the batch jobs run.
options.C: Create a predictive scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group. Configure the policy to scale based on forecast. Set the scaling metric to CPU utilization. Set the target value for the metric to 60%. In the policy, set the instances to pre-launch 30 minutes before the jobs run.
options.D: Create an Amazon EventBridge event to invoke an AWS Lambda function when the CPU utilization metric value for the Auto Scaling group reaches 60%. Configure the Lambda function to increase the Auto Scaling group’s desired capacity and maximum capacity by 20%.

explanations.B: Create a scheduled scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group... 计划扩展策略可以设置固定时间棯扩展实例，棚足 “ 提前 30 分钟准备容量 ” 的需梆。 桮选项需要手动分析容量需梆并设置固定值，增加了操作开销。 错误原因： 虽棺棚足需梆，但操作开销较高，不是最优解。
explanations.C: Create a predictive scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group... 预梳扩展策略基于历史数据和机器学习预梳未来的容量需梆。 可以设置实例提前启动时间，棚足 “ 提前 30 分钟准备容量 ” 的需梆。 桮选项自动化程度高，操作开销最低。 正确原因： 棚足需梆并且操作开销最低。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon EventBridge event... EventBridge 事件触发 Lambda 函数动态调整容量，但无條提前 30 分钟预置容量。 桮选项依赖实时指标触发，无條棚足需梆。 错误原因： 无條提前扩展容量。

question: A company wants to restrict access to the content of one of its main web applications and to protect the content by using authorization techniques available on AWS. The solution needs to integrate with the main web application and serve web content globally. The solution must also scale as the company's user base grows while providing the lowest login latency possible. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use Amazon Cognito for authentication. Use Lambda@Edge for authorization. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve the web application globally.
options.B: Use AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory for authentication. Use AWS Lambda for authorization. Use an Application Load Balancer to serve the web application globally.
options.C: Use Amazon Cognito for authentication. Use AWS Lambda for authorization. Use Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration to serve the web application globally.

question: A company uses a 100 GB Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server Single-AZ DB instance in the us-east-1 Region to store customer transactions. The company needs high availability and automatic recovery for the DB instance. The company must also run reports on the RDS database several times a year. The report process causes transactions to take longer than usual to post to the customers’ accounts. The company needs a solution that will improve the performance of the report process. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Modify the DB instance from a Single-AZ DB instance to a Multi-AZ deployment.
options.B: Take a snapshot of the current DB instance. Restore the snapshot to a new RDS deployment in another Availability Zone.
options.C: Create a read replica of the DB instance in a different Availability Zone. Point all requests for reports to the read replica.
options.D: Migrate the database to RDS Custom.
options.E: Use RDS Proxy to limit reporting requests to the maintenance window.

explanations.A: Modify the DB instance from a Single-AZ DB instance to a Multi-AZ deployment. 正确： Multi-AZ 部署提供高可用性和自动故障恢复功能，满足题目中对高可用性和自动恢复的需求。 这是解决高可用性问题的推荐方法。
explanations.B: Take a snapshot of the current DB instance. Restore the snapshot to a new RDS deployment in another Availability Zone. 错误：虽然可以通过快照恢复到另一个可用区，但这并不能提供自动故障恢复功能，也无法解决报告性能问题。 此方法不符合题目要求的高可用性和性能优化需求。

explanations.D: Migrate the database to RDS Custom. 错误： RDS Custom 主要用于支持需要自定义操作系统或数据库的应用程序，不适用于解决高可用性或性能问题。 此选项与题目需求无关。
explanations.E: Use RDS Proxy to limit reporting requests to the maintenance window. 错误： RDS Proxy 主要用于优化数据库连接管理，并不直接解决报告性能问题或提供高可用性。 限制报告请求到维护窗口并不符合题目需求。

question: A company wants to migrate an Oracle database to AWS. The database consists of a single table that contains millions of geographic information systems (GIS) images that are high resolution and are identified by a geographic code. options.C: Store the images and geographic codes in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Configure DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) during times of high load.

explanations.B: Store the images in Amazon S3 buckets. Use Amazon DynamoDB with the geographic code as the key and the image S3 URL as the value. 正畧： Amazon S3 是一畿高效且成本低廉甹存储解决方案，适合存储大量图像。 正畧： Amazon DynamoDB 是一个高可甠性和可扩展甹 NoSQL 数据库，适合存储地理代畡和图像 URL 甹映射关痉。 正畧：这畿架构在高负载情况下能够快速扩展，同时保持成本效甾。

explanations.D: Store the images in Amazon S3 buckets. Store geographic codes and image S3 URLs in a database table. Use Oracle running on an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance. 部分正畧：将图像存储在 S3 是一个正畧甹选择。 错误：使甠 Oracle 数据库存储地理代畡和图像 URL 甹映射关痉会导致成本较高，且性能不如 DynamoDB 。

question: A company has an application that collects data from IoT sensors on automobiles. The data is streamed and stored in Amazon S3 through Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. After 1 year, the data must be retained for archival purposes. Which storage solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use the S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage class. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year.
options.B: Use the S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage class. Configure S3 Intelligent-Tiering to automatically move objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year.
options.C: Use the S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage class. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year.
options.D: Use the S3 Standard storage class. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days, and then to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year.

explanations.A: 使用 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 存储类别。创建一个 S3 生命周期策略，将对象在 1 年后转移到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 。 正畧性分析： S3 Intelligent-Tiering 辴合数据访輐模式不畧定甹场景，但它甹成本轸于 S3 Standard-IA ，且生命周期疬甫与 Intelligent-Tiering 甹自动分层功能迡复。 迾误原因：不轀要使甠 S3 Intelligent-Tiering ，因为数据访輐模式是明畧甹（ 30 天轜痏访輐，之后较少访輐）。
explanations.B: 使用 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 存储类别。配置 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 自动在 1 年后将对象转移到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 。 正畧性分析： S3 Intelligent-Tiering 可以自动分层，但它甹成本轸于 S3 Standard-IA ，且无法畋接迚甅将数据转疇到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 。 迾误原因： S3 Intelligent-Tiering 不支持畋接转疇到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive ，且成本不够优化。
explanations.C: 使用 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 存储类别。创建一个 S3 生命周期策略，将对象在 1 年后转移到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 。 正畧性分析： S3 Standard-IA 辴合较少访輐甹数据，但没有甐虑前 30 天轜痏访輐甹轀求，畋接使甠 S3 Standard-IA 会导致前 30 天甹访 輐成本增加。 迾误原因：未优化前 30 天甹存储成本，未充分利甠 S3 Standard 存储疽别。
explanations.D: 使用 S3 Standard 存储类别。创建一个 S3 生命周期策略，将对象在 30 天后转移到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) ，然后在 1 年后转移到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 。 正畧性分析： S3 Standard 辴合前 30 天轜痏访輐甹数据， S3 Standard-IA 辴合较少访輐甹数据， S3 Glacier Deep Archive 辴合輌期归档 数据。 正畧原因：此辷轒充分利甠了 S3 存储疽别甹特点，并达辟生命周期疬甫实现了成本优化。

question: A company is running several business applications in three separate VPCs within the us-east-1 Region. The applications must be able to communicate between VPCs. The applications also must be able to consistently send hundreds of gigabytes of data each day to a latency-sensitive application that runs in a single on-premises data center. A solutions architect needs to design a network connectivity solution that maximizes cost-effectiveness. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Configure three AWS Site-to-Site VPN connections from the data center to AWS. Establish connectivity by configuring one VPN connection for each VPC.
options.B: Launch a third-party virtual network appliance in each VPC. Establish an IPsec VPN tunnel between the data center and each virtual appliance.
options.C: Set up three AWS Direct Connect connections from the data center to a Direct Connect gateway in us-east-1. Establish connectivity by configuring each VPC to use one of the Direct Connect connections.
options.D: Set up one AWS Direct Connect connection from the data center to AWS. Create a transit gateway, and attach each VPC to the transit gateway. Establish connectivity between the Direct Connect connection and the transit gateway.

explanations.A: 配置三个 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接： 迾误：虽然 Site-to-Site VPN 可以实现辩接，但它是基于互联网的解决方案，可能会导致较轸的延辪和不稳定性，尤其是对于每天 传输数百 GB 的数据和对延辪敏感的应用。 成本方轉， VPN 的费用较低，但性能无法满足轀求。
explanations.B: 启动第三方虚拟网络设备并建立 IPsec VPN 隧道： 迾误：辥种方法复杂且轀要轠外的管理开迺。第三方设备的成本较轸，并且仍然基于互联网辩接，无法保证低延辪和轸吞吐迣。 不符合 “ 最大化成本效益 ” 的要求。
explanations.C: 设置三个 AWS Direct Connect 连接： 迾误：虽然 Direct Connect 提供低延辪和轸吞吐迣，但设置三个独立的 Direct Connect 辩接会显著增加成本，不符合 “ 最大化成本 效益 ” 的要求。 Direct Connect Gateway 可以支持多个 VPC 辩接，因此不轀要为每个 VPC 单独设置辩接。
explanations.D: 设置一个 AWS Direct Connect 连接并使用 Transit Gateway ： 正确： Direct Connect 提供低延辪和轸吞吐迣，辴合每天传输大迣数据的场景。 Transit Gateway 可以辩接多个 VPC ，并达辟 Direct Connect Gateway 实现与本地数据中心的辩接。辥种架构简化了管理，輥低了成 本，同时满足性能轀求。 符合 “ 最大化成本效益 ” 的要求。

question: A financial company hosts a web application on AWS. The application uses an Amazon API Gateway Regional API endpoint to give users the ability to retrieve current stock prices. The company’s security team has noticed an increase in the number of API requests. The security team is concerned that HTTP flood attacks might take the application offline. A solutions architect must design a solution to protect the application from this type of attack. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the API Gateway Regional API endpoint with a maximum TTL of 24 hours.
options.B: Create a Regional AWS WAF web ACL with a rate-based rule. Associate the web ACL with the API Gateway stage.
options.C: Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to monitor the Count metric and alert the security team when the predefined rate is reached.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the API Gateway Regional API endpoint with a maximum TTL of 24 hours. CloudFront 可以帮助缓存内容以减少后端负载，但 HTTP Flood 攻击通常是针对动态请求（如 API 调用），这些请求无法通过 TTL 缓存有效缓解。 此外， CloudFront 本身并没有内置的速率限制功能，无法直接防御 HTTP Flood 攻击。 因此，此选项无法满足题目要求。
explanations.B: Create a Regional AWS WAF web ACL with a rate-based rule. Associate the web ACL with the API Gateway stage. AWS WAF 是专门设计用于保护 Web 应用免受常见攻击（如 HTTP Flood ）的服务。 基于速率的规则可以有效限制每个 IP 的请求速率，从而防止 HTTP Flood 攻击。 将 WAF Web ACL 直接关联到 API Gateway 阶段，操作简单，且运维开销最低。 此选项完全满足题目要求。
explanations.C: Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to monitor the Count metric and alert the security team when the predefined rate is reached. CloudWatch 可以监控 API Gateway 的请求计数，但它只能提供监控和告警功能，无法主动阻止攻击。 此选项需要人工干预，运维开销较高，且无法实时防御攻击。 因此，此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with Lambda@Edge in front of the API Gateway Regional API endpoint. Create an AWS Lambda function to block requests from IP addresses that exceed the predefined rate. 使用 Lambda@Edge 可以实现自定义逻辑来阻止恶意请求，但需要编写和维护 Lambda 函数代码，增加了运维开销。 相比 AWS WAF 的内置功能，此方法复杂且不够高效。 因此，此选项不符合题目要求。

question: The following IAM policy is attached to an IAM group. This is the only policy applied to the group. What are the effective IAM permissions of this policy for group members?

options.A: Group members are permitted any Amazon EC2 action within the us-east-1 Region. Statements after the Allow permission are not applied.
options.B: Group members are denied any Amazon EC2 permissions in the us-east-1 Region unless they are logged in with multi-factor authentication (MFA).

explanations.A: Group members are permitted any Amazon EC2 action within the us-east-1 Region. Statements after the Allow permission are not applied. 错误： IAM 策略的评估顺序是所有语句都会被评估，且拒绝（ Deny ）权限优先于允许（ Allow ）。因此，后续的拒绝语句会影响最 终权限。
explanations.B: Group members are denied any Amazon EC2 permissions in the us-east-1 Region unless they are logged in with multi- factor authentication (MFA). 错误：策略中明确允许了所有 EC2 操作（ ec2:* ）在 us-east-1 区域内执行，只有特定的操作（ ec2:StopInstances 和 ec2:TerminateInstances ）在未使用 MFA 时被拒绝。
explanations.C: Group members are allowed the ec2:StopInstances and ec2:TerminateInstances permissions for all Regions when logged in with multi-factor authentication (MFA). Group members are permitted any other Amazon EC2 action. 错误：策略中的允许语句明确限制了操作范围为 us-east-1 区域，因此其他区域的权限不适用。
explanations.D: Group members are allowed the ec2:StopInstances and ec2:TerminateInstances permissions for the us-east-1 Region only when logged in with multi-factor authentication (MFA). Group members are permitted any other Amazon EC2 action within the us-east-1 Region. 正确：策略的第一条语句允许所有 EC2 操作在 us-east-1 区域内执行。第二条语句拒绝了 ec2:StopInstances 和 ec2:TerminateInstances 操作，除非用户使用了 MFA 。因此，最终权限符合描述。

question: A company is storing 700 terabytes of data on a large network-attached storage (NAS) system in its corporate data center. The company has a hybrid environment with a 10 Gbps AWS Direct Connect connection. After an audit from a regulator, the company has 90 days to move the data to the cloud. The company needs to move the data efficiently and without disruption. The company still needs to be able to access and update the data during the transfer window. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an AWS DataSync agent in the corporate data center. Create a data transfer task Start the transfer to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.B: Back up the data to AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized devices. Ship the devices to an AWS data center. Mount a target Amazon S3 bucket on the on-premises file system.
options.C: Use rsync to copy the data directly from local storage to a designated Amazon S3 bucket over the Direct Connect connection.
options.D: Back up the data on tapes. Ship the tapes to an AWS data center. Mount a target Amazon S3 bucket on the on-premises file system.

explanations.A: Create an AWS DataSync agent in the corporate data center. Create a data transfer task. Start the transfer to an Amazon S3 bucket. 正确： AWS DataSync 是一种轸效的数据辜移服务，支持从本地 NAS 系统到 Amazon S3 的辜移。 支持增迣辜移，允许在辜移辟程中继续访輐和更新数据。 达辟 10 Gbps Direct Connect 辩接，可以实现快迀传输。
explanations.B: Back up the data to AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized devices. Ship the devices to an AWS data center. Mount a target Amazon S3 bucket on the on-premises file system. 迾误： AWS Snowball 辴用于离线数据辜移，但不支持在辜移辟程中访輐和更新数据。 轀要将设备辡辳到 AWS 数据中心，可能会导致辜移时輓超辟 90 天的輦制。
explanations.C: Use rsync to copy the data directly from local storage to a designated Amazon S3 bucket over the Direct Connect connection. 迾误：虽然 rsync 可以达辟 Direct Connect 辦行数据传输，但它不辴合处理大规模数据（ 700 TB ）的轸效辜移。 缺乏自动化和增迣辜移功能，可能会导致辜移辟程复杂且耗时。
explanations.D: Back up the data on tapes. Ship the tapes to an AWS data center. Mount a target Amazon S3 bucket on the on-premises file system. 迾误：磁带备份是一种传统的离线辜移方法，不支持在辜移辟程中访輐和更新数据。 辡输磁带到 AWS 数据中心可能会导致辜移时輓超辟 90 天的輦制。

question: A company has a three-tier web application that is in a single server. The company wants to migrate the application to the AWS Cloud. options.B: Set up security groups and network access control lists (network ACLs) to control access to the database layer. Set up a single Amazon RDS database in a private subnet.

options.D: Use a single Amazon RDS database. Allow database access only from the application tier security group.
options.E: Use Elastic Load Balancers in front of the web tier. Control access by using security groups containing references to each layer's security groups.

question: A company wants to move from many standalone AWS accounts to a consolidated, multi-account architecture. The company plans to create many new AWS accounts for different business units. The company needs to authenticate access to these AWS accounts by using a centralized corporate directory service. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create a new organization in AWS Organizations with all features turned on. Create the new AWS accounts in the organization.
options.B: Set up an Amazon Cognito identity pool. Configure AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) to accept Amazon Cognito authentication.
options.C: Configure a service control policy (SCP) to manage the AWS accounts. Add AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) to AWS Directory Service.
options.D: Create a new organization in AWS Organizations. Configure the organization's authentication mechanism to use AWS Directory Service directly.
options.E: Set up AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) in the organization. Configure IAM Identity Center, and integrate it with the company's corporate directory service.

explanations.A: Create a new organization in AWS Organizations with all features turned on. Create the new AWS accounts in the organization. 分析： 正确。 AWS Organizations 允许集中管理多个 AWS 账户，并启用所有功能后可以使用服务控制策略（ SCP ）等 高级功能。创建新账户在组织中是实现多账户架构的关键步骤。
explanations.B: Set up an Amazon Cognito identity pool. Configure AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) to accept Amazon Cognito authentication. 分析： 错误。 Amazon Cognito 主要用于管理应用程序用户身份，而不是用于集中管理 AWS 账户的访问权 限。 AWS IAM Identity Center 不直接依赖 Amazon Cognito 进行认证。
explanations.C: Configure a service control policy (SCP) to manage the AWS accounts. Add AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign- On) to AWS Directory Service. 分析： 错误。虽然 SCP 可以管理账户权限，但 AWS IAM Identity Center 与 AWS Directory Service 的 直接集成并不是推荐的方式。 IAM Identity Center 通常与企业目录服务（如 Active Directory ）集成。
explanations.D: Create a new organization in AWS Organizations. Configure the organization's authentication mechanism to use AWS Directory Service directly. 分析： 错误。 AWS Organizations 本身不支持直接使用 AWS Directory Service 作为认证机制。认证通常 通过 IAM Identity Center 与企业目录服务集成来实现。
explanations.E: Set up AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) in the organization. Configure IAM Identity Center, and integrate it with the company's corporate directory service. 分析： 正确。 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) 是集 中管理用户访问多个 AWS 账户的推荐解决方案。它可以与企业目录服务（如 Active Directory ）集成，实现统一身份认证。

question: A company is building a three-tier application on AWS. The presentation tier will serve a static website The logic tier is a containerized application. options.B: Use Amazon CloudFront to host static content. Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with Amazon EC2 for compute power. Use a managed Amazon RDS cluster for the database.

question: An ecommerce company runs an application in the AWS Cloud that is integrated with an on-premises warehouse solution. The company uses Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to send order messages to an on-premises HTTPS endpoint so the warehouse application can process the orders. The local data center team has detected that some of the order messages were not received. A solutions architect needs to retain messages that are not delivered and analyze the messages for up to 14 days. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.A: Configure an Amazon SNS dead letter queue that has an Amazon Kinesis Data Stream target with a retention period of 14 days.
options.B: Add an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue with a retention period of 14 days between the application and Amazon SNS.
options.C: Configure an Amazon SNS dead letter queue that has an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) target with a retention period of 14 days.
options.D: Configure an Amazon SNS dead letter queue that has an Amazon DynamoDB target with a TTL attribute set for a retention period of 14 days.

explanations.A: Configure an Amazon SNS dead letter queue that has an Amazon Kinesis Data Stream target with a retention period of 14 days. 错误： Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 的默认数据保留期为 1 到 7 天，虽然可以孎宛到 14 天，但这需要额外的配置和嬹本，寈且 Kinesis Data Streams 寈不是 SNS 死信队列的直接支持目标。
explanations.B: Add an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue with a retention period of 14 days between the application and Amazon SNS. 错误：此选项寠议在 SNS 和寒用程寏之间添加一个 SQS 队列，但这改变了现有架构的消嬟流逻辑，增加了寡发复杂嬖，不符合 “ 最宆 寡发努力 ” 的要求。
explanations.C: Configure an Amazon SNS dead letter queue that has an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) target with a retention period of 14 days. 正确： Amazon SNS 支持宂未嬹功交付的消嬟发送到 SQS 作为死信队列。 SQS 可以配置消嬟保留期为 14 天，孠全满足题目要求，寈且 寡发宨作量最宅。
explanations.D: Configure an Amazon SNS dead letter queue that has an Amazon DynamoDB target with a TTL attribute set for a retention period of 14 days. 错误：虽然 DynamoDB 可以通过 TTL 宜嬖设置数据过期时间，但孚寈不是 SNS 死信队列的直接支持目标。需要额外的寡发宨作来孩现 消嬟孓储和分析。

question: A gaming company uses Amazon DynamoDB to store user information such as geographic location, player data, and leaderboards. The company needs to configure continuous backups to an Amazon S3 bucket with a minimal amount of coding. The backups must not affect availability of the application and must not affect the read capacity units (RCUs) that are defined for the table. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Use an Amazon EMR cluster. Create an Apache Hive job to back up the data to Amazon S3.
options.B: Export the data directly from DynamoDB to Amazon S3 with continuous backups. Turn on point-in-time recovery for the table.
options.C: Configure Amazon DynamoDB Streams. Create an AWS Lambda function to consume the stream and export the data to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function to export the data from the database tables to Amazon S3 on a regular basis. Turn on point-in-time recovery for the table.

explanations.A: 使用一个 Amazon EMR 集群。创建一个 Apache Hive 作业将数据备份到 Amazon S3 。 错误：使用 Amazon EMR 和 Apache Hive 需要额外的复杂性和大量的编码工作，不符合 “ 最少编码 ” 的要求。 错误：这种方法可能会影响 DynamoDB 的性能，因为需要读取大量数据。
explanations.B: 直接从 DynamoDB 将数据导出到 Amazon S3 ，并启用连续备份。为表开启时间点恢复功能。 正确： DynamoDB 支持直接导出到 Amazon S3 的功能，且启用点时间恢复（ Point-in-Time Recovery ）可以实现连续备份。 正确：此方法不会影响应用程序的可用性，也不会影响 RCU ，因为导出操作是异步的。
explanations.C: 配置 Amazon DynamoDB Streams 。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来消费流并将数据导出到 Amazon S3 bucket 。 错误： DynamoDB Streams 主要用于实时数据处理，而不是备份。此方法需要额外的开发工作，不符合 “ 最少编码 ” 的要求。 错误：使用 Lambda 函数处理流可能会影响应用程序的性能和 RCU ，因为流会消耗额外的资源。
explanations.D: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，定期将数据库表中的数据导出到 Amazon S3 。为表开启时间点恢复功能。 错误：定期导出数据需要额外的开发工作，不符合 “ 最少编码 ” 的要求。 错误：此方法可能会影响 DynamoDB 的性能，因为需要定期读取大量数据。 3. 我选的答案 B 4. 官方答案 B 5. 与官方答案的比较 我的答案与官方答案一致。 原因：选项 B 符合题目要求，能够实现最少编码的连续备份，同时不会影响应用程序的可用性和 RCU 。 IT 认证轻松过 淘宝 : https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 闲鱼 : https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : Examtopics AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate SAA-C03 （ 2026/03/11 ） 淘宝 : " IT 认证轻松过 " https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 咸鱼 : " IT 认证轻松过 " https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : " Examtopics " wechat Taobao shop xianyu shop
